comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The historical research in this script is absolutely phenomenal. I have watched countless travel documentaries, but the story of Warsaw rebuilding 85% of its pulverized city out of "rubble concrete" simply by following the 250-year-old brushstrokes of an Italian painter [09:40] is one of the most profound acts of national defiance I've ever heard of. It gives a completely new meaning to the UNESCO World Heritage status. Bravo! 👏

replies.author: @reallifeincountries
replies.text: Huge thanks for the deep dive into that Warsaw rebuilding story! 🇵🇱 🎨 That resilience and dedication to history is truly unmatched. Did that specific segment surprise you?"
